endorsements.name: Michael Rogers
endorsements.label: Steganographic Trojans
endorsements.description: As anti-virus manufacturers develop more efficient techniques for stopping an infection, potential attackers must become more cunning and resourceful in their deployment methodologies; they must create "invisible" code...but how? What are the possibilities of developing an invisible virus or Trojan?
